objections.quote: Hmm, a bit more than I'd thought.

coaching_tip: Keep doing what you did at 00:51 and 01:10: give the full gold, making and GST breakup up front, then price the other chains openly so the customer can choose for himself.
flags: asked range of fifteen to thirty grams mapped to band 15-30, although 15 g alone would fall in the lower band
price_budget objection raised without a stated budget: customer said only that the price was more than expected
durability question at 00:28 not scored as an objection: salesperson answered it and the customer did not push back

customer.intent_evidence: 00:08 asked for a daily-wear chain between fifteen and thirty grams

key_moments.what: showed three chains, all within the asked weight range
answered the durability concern and pointed out the hallmark and HUID
priced the alternatives honestly, including the trade-offs
chose the sturdier rope chain over the cheaper one

price_talk.notes: breakup of gold, making and GST given at 00:51
